verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents brute-force protection: it blocks suspicious IPs after consecutive failed login attempts, and its changelog adds a configurable unblock mode for Brute Force Protection. Breached-password detection, which notifies or blocks users with compromised credentials, partly addresses credential stuffing. Bot detection is not evidenced at all, and the brute-force and credential-stuffing evidence is thin (use-case blurbs and a changelog title). missing for 10: documented bot detection/CAPTCHA protection, explicit credential-stuffing detection beyond breached-password checks, in-depth configuration docs for brute-force protection, independent or hands-on corroboration.
